name: Forliaukarli
backstory: Child of Forliauzco and Farliukar in Terfila; raised alongside unloads crates at the market stalls through the..., having heard about Toll Ledger Arrears.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Forliarlo has died.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuken and Forliazco now have a child, Forliuken.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Forliamuk and Tamuzco now have a child, Tamuzmuken.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuzco and Farliukar now have a child, Tamuzarlo.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Tamuzakar.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Farliazco, named Forliuzazco.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Forliamuk, named Forliauken.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Farliazco, named Farliauzco.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Forliuken, named Forliukar.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Birth Of Tamuzarlo their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Birth Of Tamuzarlo as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the transit route on his own errands when the harbor's dead time drags on, and can't pass the temple without pausing, the way the family always has.

arc.premise: Forliaukarli has stopped waiting on the Salthos house to answer whether their mediating role was ever formally offered, and started commissioning a charter stone for the market entrance naming it outright - settled by declaration, if not by record.
